newsitem.title: USA: New Era Tech chairman resigns.
newsitem.headline: New Era Tech chairman resigns.

text.p: New Era Technologies International Inc said Tuesday that Stephen Fleming, its chairman, acting president, and chief executive resigned to pursue "other business opportunities."
Fleming also resigned as chairman and president of New Era subsidiary, International ION Inc, the company said.
The company said that its board of directors will fill the vacant positions "shortly."
New Era did not say how long Fleming had been in those positions. It did not immediately return a telephone call.
